name: chat-app

scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:client && REQUIRE_INTEGRATION=1 npm --prefix server test
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.spec.json && npm --prefix server run typecheck

//overrides: Transitive advisories with no fix reachable by bumping the direct dependency.
brace-expansion: nx 23.1.1 pins 5.0.8 exactly; GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895 is fixed
esbuild: vite 7.3.5 asks for ^0.27.0 and GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr has no fix on
the 0.27 line, so closing it means crossing that range to 0.28.1.
@angular/cli. npm's own answer here is @angular/cli@21.0.4, which is a
*downgrade* out of the 22 line this workspace is pinned to (@angular/core
^22.0.7) — the 22.x releases are all inside the advisory range, so there is
no forward fix to take. The override is the smaller change.
The latter two knowingly cross a declared range; both are dev-only and were
verified against a full build and the test suites rather than on npm's word.
